title: Mining Hotspots
author: CMDR Snickerdoodlez
description: The nearest ring hotspots for a commodity (Platinum, Painite, Low Temperature Diamonds, Void Opals…) around your system or one you type, from Spansh: ring, ring type, how many hotspots of it the ring has, reserve and distance. Plus every hotspot you've mapped yourself, from your own journals.
